reference_sql:
SELECT year(order_date) AS order_year,
       quarter(order_date) AS order_quarter,
       SUM(units) AS units
FROM sales
GROUP BY year(order_date), quarter(order_date)
alternatives: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM order_date) AS order_year, EXTRACT(quarter FROM order_date) AS order_quarter, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY 1, 2
SELECT year(date_trunc('quarter', order_date)) AS order_year, quarter(date_trunc('quarter', order_date)) AS order_quarter, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', order_date)

other_way.sql: SELECT year(date_trunc('quarter', order_date)) AS order_year, quarter(date_trunc('quarter', order_date)) AS order_quarter, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', order_date)
other_way.tradeoff: Grouping by each quarter's first day with date_trunc works too, but you then read the year and the quarter back out of it.

SELECT year(order_date) AS order_year, quarter(order_date) AS order_quarter, COUNT(*) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY 1, 2
